profileLabel: Center-left economics; strongly institution-supporting on transparency (medium confidence)
summary: Bulacan 5th District representative with 154 principal-authored bills. Authored FOI, budget blockchain transparency, bank anti-corruption rules, contract bans for officials' relatives, stronger AMLC, right to adequate food, dialysis in all hospitals, worker insurance, SSS/PhilHealth penalty condonation, tax indexation and a one-time tax amnesty.
caveat: Bill-based evidence only; no oversight conduct or votes reviewed. Single gender bill left social values unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored right to adequate food (-3), dialysis in all hospitals (-2), mandatory worker insurance (-2) and contribution-penalty condonation (-1); tax indexation (-1) offset by a one-time general tax amnesty (+2).
